name: Hauling Arms
description: Two arms curled inward with a body caught between them, still being pulled. The find turns the bite's shove around — everything a claw closes on is dragged in toward you — so the plate closes where Eighth Leg's fans open, which is how the two are told apart in silhouette before either is read. One `mirrorX` part draws the pair, so the two arms cannot drift out of symmetry.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
